name: Question 13
problem:
Suppose that the following elementary row operations are applied to a $3\times 3$ matrix $A$ in the given order:

$$
{R}_{1}:=-5{R}_{1},\,{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}-4{R}_{3}
$$

What is the equivalent notation in terms of matrix multiplication?
worked_solution:
First, let's find the elementary matrices corresponding to the given elementary row operations.

- The first operation is ${R}_{1}:=-5{R}_{1}.$ The corresponding elementary matrix can be found by applying this same elementary row operation to the identity matrix as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}I & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=-5{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & ={E}_{1}\end{aligned}
$$

- The second operation is ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}-4{R}_{3}.$ The corresponding elementary matrix can be found by applying this same elementary row operation to the identity matrix as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}I & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-4{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & ={E}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

To apply the first elementary row operation to the matrix $A,$ we multiply by ${E}_{1}$ on the left and get ${E}_{1}A:$

$$
[\begin{aligned}-5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot A
$$

Then, to apply the second elementary row operation to ${E}_{1}A,$ we multiply by ${E}_{2}$ on the left and get ${E}_{2}{E}_{1}A:$

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}-5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\cdot A
$$

Question 13
?

Suppose that the following elementary row operations are applied to a 3×3 matrix A in the given order: R1:=−5R1,R2:=R2−4R3 What is the equivalent notation in terms of matrix multiplication?

a
[10001−4001]⋅[−500010001]⋅A
b
[100014001]⋅[500010001]⋅A
c
[1000−5000−4]⋅[1000−50001]⋅A
d
[10−401000−5]⋅[10001000−5]⋅A
e
[−500010001]⋅[10001−4001]⋅A
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, let's find the elementary matrices corresponding to the given elementary row operations.

  • The first operation is R1:=−5R1. The corresponding elementary matrix can be found by applying this same elementary row operation to the identity matrix as follows: I=[100010001]R1:=−5R1∼[−500010001]=E1

  • The second operation is R2:=R2−4R3. The corresponding elementary matrix can be found by applying this same elementary row operation to the identity matrix as follows: I=[100010001]R2:=R2−4R3∼[10001−4001]=E2

To apply the first elementary row operation to the matrix A, we multiply by E1 on the left and get E1A:

[−500010001]⋅A

Then, to apply the second elementary row operation to E1A, we multiply by E2 on the left and get E2E1A:

[10001−4001]⋅[−500010001]⋅A
